cases.name: Cheryl Ann Commesso
cases.caseStatus: CONVICTION; COLD CASE W/ FUGITIVE SUSPECT
cases.narrative: In 1995, her skeletal remains were found by a landscaper in an area off Interstate 275 near Tampa, FL. Photos were found taped to the gas tank of Floyd’s pickup truck that showed him sexually abusing 2 girls and photos of a woman tied up and beaten to death. Years later, the woman—Cheryl Ann Comesso—was identified and matched to her remains.
